desired_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: rabbitmq-dev
  namespace: rabbitmq-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: rabbitmq-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    app.kubernetes.io/version: 4.1.3
    helm.sh/chart: rabbitmq-16.0.14
    environment: dev
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  sessionAffinity: None
  ports:
  - name: amqp
    port: 5672
    targetPort: amqp
    nodePort: null
  - name: epmd
    port: 4369
    targetPort: epmd
    nodePort: null
  - name: dist
    port: 25672
    targetPort: dist
    nodePort: null
  - name: http-stats
    port: 15672
    targetPort: stats
    nodePort: null
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: rabbitmq-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
